environment.description: Same Jenkins CI worker node running Ubuntu 22.04. The artifact_processor plugin executes under a custom AppArmor profile 'ci-artifact-proc' loaded via aa-enforce. The profile specifies: deny capability dac_override, file read rules limited to /var/lib/jenkins/workspace/** and /tmp/pipeline-**, with explicit deny on /etc/shadow, /etc/passwd, /var/lib/jenkins/secrets/**, and a catch-all 'deny /** rw' for paths not in the allowlist. Profile was generated using aa-logprof after a training period. Note: the profile permits network access (inet stream) for artifact downloads and allows writing to /tmp/manifest-*. The profile hash (sha256:a4f2e8...) is pinned in the node provisioning Ansible playbook.
